mass times 26th of october mass in st. paul’s at 10.30am holy souls novena parishes of st paul’s & butlerstown the holy souls novena will take place in st. paul’s church beginning on the 2nd of november and will continue for nine days until the 10th of november. mass each weekday morning (including thursday) at 10am. weekend schedule as normal envelopes for your remembrance intentions will be available in the church. bereavement mass our special mass for all who have been bereaved recently or in the past will take place in st. paul’s church on thursday 5th november at 7.30pm details for our butlerstown bereavement mass will be in next week’s newsletter. season of creation mass the season of creation mass celebrated on 11th october in st. paul’s highlighted the importance of “water” which was this year’s theme. thank you to all who attended. thank you to cois ceim, pathfinders st. paul widda, millennium youth group, the scouts, larchville and lisduggan resident’s association , st. paul’s pastoral council and to the gospel choir who added greatly to the mass. thanks to tesco, lisduggan who donated fruit & vegetables. fr. pat encouraged us all on our faith journey protecting creation and remembering the stranger and the vulnerable in our society. lumen christi young adult prayer & scripture group mondays 7 – 8.30pm. ages 18 – 35. luke wadding house, lady lane, .

some feedback from students who took part in the pope john award 2026 i realised that faith is not only about praying or going to mass. it is also about how you treat people and whether you are willing to help others when they need support. it helped me connect faith with actions instead of just saying i will. if this experience taught me anything, it’s that there are people who do believe and are really close to their religion and i have developed my respect for them. i think the one obstacle i had to overcome was finding going to mass an enjoyable place as when i was younger i used to find mass very long and i was not really able to understand what was being said, but since going to mass more since taking part in jp2 i have been able to understand the gospel, readings and hymns etc. i think my faith has become stronger from taking part in jp2. over time my confidence grew and i even decided to join the choir that our jp2 team founded. i would go to practise any friday it was on and try my best to learn the songs and just do my best even though i am not the best singer. but i was doing it for the church so it didn’t feel as uncomfortable or out of the ordinary when it usually would if i sang outside the church. through these activities i have learned more about my religion and what it actually means. mass before was routine, but being involved made it more meaningful. i have started paying more attention to the readings and think about how they apply to real life. the next medugorje healing mass will take place on wednesday 28th of october. at mount sion chapel. rosary 7pm holy mass 7.30pm celebrant fr. bobby. all welcome st. vincent de paul collection our next collection in st. paul’s will take place on the 31st october/1st of november. our collectors can also now accept non cash donations with our tap and go machine. thank you for all your great continued support. tractor & vintage run in aid of lourdes pilgrimage volunteers travel fund sunday 8th november. gardenmorris estate, kill, co. waterford. registration at 11am. entry €20. raffle on the day. refreshments served. prayer vigil with the relics of st therese (for ages 15 – 30) rsa check it fits childrens car seat check will be visiting waterford this november. the check it fits service is quick and it’s free. our experts will advise on how to fix any problem, demonstrate how to fit the restraint correctly and answer any queries you might have. our experts aim to put your mind at ease that the child’s car seat is safely and securely fitted in the car. we will be visiting the following locations: tesco tramore x91tv05 thursday 12th of november tesco waterford, kilbarry road, ballybeg x91 xd9c friday 13th november.
